<thought>The proton NMR spectra show signals at 2.62 ppm (triplet, 2H), 2.77 ppm (triplet, 2H), 7.18 ppm (doublet of doublet of doublets, 2H), and 7.36 ppm (doublet of doublet of doublets, 2H). The signals at 2.62 and 2.77 ppm are likely from aliphatic protons adjacent to the aromatic ring, possibly indicating an ethyl group. Given the molecular weight, carbon, and proton NMR data, the compound could be ethylbenzene. I will validate this hypothesis by generating the SMILES for ethylbenzene and checking its chemical formula.</thought>
<action>get_formula_from_smiles</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "CCc1ccccc1"}</action_input>
